newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hub Power gains 3.01 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hub Power gains 3.01 percent.

text.p: Pakistan's blue chip Hub Power Co Ltd rose 1.10 rupees, or 3.01 percent, to 37.60 on Sunday after its Global Depositary Receipt (GDR) price gained in international markets, dealers said.
The stock emerged as volume leader with a turnover of over 1.63 million shares in early trade.
"It is a safe bet, a solid blue-chip investment," said Manochar Jamal, chief dealer of Taurus Securities.
He said Hub Power's equity rating was the best in the Pakistani market and investors had guaranteed returns.
"For foreign funds, it is a natural choice."
